doc: Identification of severe acute malnutrition in infants under 6 months of age

entries.claim: 6个月以下婴儿严重急性营养不良定义为身长别体重低于WHO儿童生长标准中位数-3个Z评分或存在双侧凹陷性水肿。
entries.source_doc: Identification of severe acute malnutrition in infants under 6 months of age

entries.claim: 6个月以下严重急性营养不良婴儿若出现任何并发症因素（如严重临床状况、近期体重下降、喂养无效、任何水肿、需详细评估的医学或社会问题）应住院治疗。
entries.source_doc: Identification of severe acute malnutrition in infants under 6 months of age
